title: Your first
connection.
lines: A guided start with Voltura Air
narration: Welcome to Voltura Air. In this guide, we'll connect your phone to your Windows PC and try the trackpad and keyboard. You don't need a mobile app or a Voltura account.

title: Download
for Windows.
narration: On your Windows eleven PC, visit voltura dot S E slash air. Follow the download link and choose the full installer. It includes the required dot net runtimes. You'll need a sixty-four-bit Windows PC.

title: Install.
Open Voltura Air.
narration: Run the installer, follow its setup prompts, then open Voltura Air. Phone Webcam is an optional component. You don't need it for this trackpad and keyboard walkthrough.

title: Same network.
Ready to pair.
lines: Put both devices on your private network
Your PC can use Ethernet or Wi-Fi
narration: Connect your phone and PC to the same private home network. Your PC can use Ethernet or Wi-Fi. Direct LAN is the default connection mode. On the PC, open the Connect page.

title: Scan your
PC's QR code.
lines: The controller opens in your browser
narration: Use your phone's camera to scan the QR code shown on your own PC, then open the detected link. The controller opens in your browser. The code in this video is only an example. Always scan your own PC's code.
note: Example QR only — scan the code on your own PC

title: Move.
Click. Scroll.
lines: Slide one finger to move the pointer
Tap to click · Two fingers to scroll
narration: Once connected, keep Touch selected on the trackpad. Slide one finger to move the PC's pointer. Tap to click, or use the Left and Right buttons. Drag two fingers to scroll.

title: Type from
your device.
lines: Focus a text field on your PC
Try a short line of text
narration: Click a text field on your PC, then choose Keyboard on the controller and try a short line of text. On a wide tablet, the keyboard and trackpad can sit side by side.

title: You're
connected.
lines: Manage access in Devices on your PC
Explore more features at your own pace
narration: You're ready to go. Manage trusted devices and their permissions from Devices on the PC. If pairing fails, check that both devices are on the same private network. Find help, downloads, and more features at voltura dot S E slash air.
note: Voltura Air · Free and open source
